what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Portugal in all host countries: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 376 Portuguese asylum seekers, and the United States hosted 52.9% of them.
After the United States, the largest hosts are Canada, Brazil and Australia.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Portugal, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2002 and 2023 to 2024.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 2000 at 73 asylum seekers.
The figure was at its highest, 1092, at the end of 2024, and was much lower at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country that reported to UNHCR.
